subject: Large multi-tab application: what are the recommendations?

messages.author: 2ef256a129b97763
messages.subject: Large multi-tab application: what are the recommendations?
parts:
I have developed a Shiny App with around 7-8 tabs (divided between 3 major topics).  Now my customer wants implemented many more tabs, 15-20 each for 3-4 topic (worst case 80 tabs!). It does make sense in the context of the analytical application they want to use.  The expected number of users is quite small: around 4/5.

I would love to develop each topic as an independent Shiny application, having one "root" Shiny app that through hyperlinks allow to call each topic. Is it possible? (In case I do not mind if I need to get a Shiny Pro license provided there are advantages in doing so).

Are there other caveats / design recommendation I should be aware of implementing such a large app?

Thanks Enzo
